Beautifully maintained and filled with natural light, this approximately 1,746-square-foot home offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms with a warm, inviting floor plan designed for both everyday living and entertaining. From the moment you enter, soaring vaulted ceilings, refined crown molding, and plantation shutters create an atmosphere of comfort and sophistication.
